name: CUE Splitter
description: Shows the tracks of single-file album images (FLAC, APE, WavPack, WAV...) described by a .cue sheet as individual songs, without splitting or modifying the original file. Tracks are decoded on the fly, sample-accurately.

versions.changelog: Fix: albums already split into one file per track whose .cue sheet uses the EAC non-compliant (gaps appended) layout had most of their tracks hidden. Tracks are now attached to the file holding their INDEX 01, and sheets with one file per track are never treated as album images.
REM DISCNUMBER values written as N/M (e.g. "1/2") are now understood (#1).
Uninstalling the plugin now removes its virtual tracks from the library (previously they stayed behind, unplayable).
Initial release: virtual tracks from CUE sheets (FLAC, APE, WavPack...), sample-accurate on-the-fly decoding, seekable streams.
